shots.line: What if you woke up tomorrow... and every other human on Earth was gone? Not dead. Just... gone.
Kai did. Six twelve a.m. No traffic. No voices. No sirens. Just a city of ten million... holding its breath.
Cars sit exactly where they stopped, engines still warm. And the traffic lights keep changing... for no one.
He walks down the middle of the road, shouting until his voice breaks. He calls his mom. It rings. And rings. And rings.
Here's the scary part. Without us, power plants run on autopilot. But with no one watching them... only for a few hours.
By sunset, the stations start failing. And one by one, district by district... the lights go out.
Total darkness. No glow on the horizon. Just stars he has never seen before. The first night of the rest of his life.
And then... far across the city... a single light switched on.
